data.name: Tousif
data.gender_notes: Tousif is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'Tusif' which means 'bringer of victory'. It is a powerful and joyful name, often given to boys in Bengali Muslim families. The name Tousif carries the meaning “Bringer of Victory” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Bengali tradition and is also used in Bengali. Parents who choose Tousif usually hope their child will grow to embody bringer of victory and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the victory of the soul over the mind and the body, and the triumph of the spiritual self over the material world.
data.etymology: Tousif belongs to the Bengali linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bringer of Victory.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Tousif total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
